problem_type: MCP tool argument validation loses its typed diagnostic code
symptom: A malformed nomi_add_nodes call returns isError but structuredContent.nomiOutcome.errorCode is null, so a client cannot classify the recoverable input failure.
direct_cause: validateToolArguments returns an untyped Error and buildToolErrorOutcome only preserves an error code found on the error object.
class_root: The shared MCP schema-validation boundary does not attach the canonical capability_input_invalid code before all tool callers enter the result projection.
affected_population: Every MCP tools/call invocation rejected by the shared JSON Schema validator
All stdio and injected MCP transports using mcpProtocol
entry_points: validateToolArguments callers across the MCP catalog
internal_only_reason: This is Nomi's internal typed error contract between the shared schema validator and MCP result projection.
invariants: Every schema validation failure carries code capability_input_invalid before result projection.
generality_proof: All MCP tools/call requests pass through validateToolArguments before tool.build or transport.invoke, so the code is attached once for every schema rejection rather than added per tool.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate the broadcast JSON Schema and attach the canonical recoverable input error code.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The protocol invokes validateToolArguments for every resolved MCP tool before dispatch.
The shared validator test suite exercises missing, wrong-typed, unknown, and ranged values.

recurrence.reason: Any current or future MCP tool whose advertised schema rejects input would otherwise lose the same machine-readable code.
same_class_scan: Checked mcpProtocol.ts and mcpArgValidation.test.ts as independent caller and class-test paths.

prevention.failure_mode: The protocol returns an MCP Tool Execution Error with isError:true and nomiOutcome.errorCode capability_input_invalid.
prevention.strategy: Annotate the single shared validator error at the earliest boundary before result formatting.

legacy_paths.rationale: No obsolete validation path exists; the existing shared path is strengthened.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is owned by Nomi's own JSON Schema validator and result projection; no third-party runtime controls it.

migration: No persisted data or caller migration is needed; the wire error gains a typed field while retaining existing text and isError semantics.
residual_risks: Provider-side failures are outside this schema-validation class and retain their existing error contracts.
